evidence_policy.claim_boundary: Offline results validate deterministic contracts and graders, not live Gemini quality, price, or service latency.

limitations: Live Gemini quality, service latency, token use, and billed cost were not measured in the offline release gate.
Public-source downloads are registry-only and require an explicit public_download run.
Offline retrieval evidence is a controlled gold replay; it is not a production retriever benchmark.
